title: One health-core web plan function
evidence: My health's layout moved (2026-11-25, US-62 AC40): MyHealth.tsx draws health-core's planTopics (topics, rows, cards, questions, placements); its hand-built rows, parts and topic presence and usePlanView's topics map are deleted, the row keys drawn by MyDataRows.tsx rowModels. Pinned by MyHealth.topics-pins.test.tsx. Brad ruled on the three differences 2026-11-26 (US-62 AC41): their constants are gone; Cancer screening shows the shared note (screening-note.ts, carried on lib/plan-forms.ts planForms), alone or under its cards; before the form is full no card shows, as decided. Remains: HealthTool.tsx still builds PlanBasis in the component
